format: CSV (normalized from USCG eNOAD / CBP ACE)
standard: USCG eNOAD (33 CFR Part 160) + CBP ACE CAMIR bill of lading fields
notes: Three related CSVs produced together with the AIS feed: vessel_arrivals.csv (one row per port call), cargo_manifest.csv (one row per bill of lading or air waybill) and port_conditions.csv (one row per Captain of the Port order and channel segment). The source systems use XML (eNOAD) and fixed-width CAMIR; the corpus normalises them to CSV. All times UTC. fuel_deliveries.csv in the same folder has its own schema file.

vessel_arrivals.description: One row per port call by an ocean-going vessel: notice of arrival, anchorage, berth, departure.

fields.name: arrival_id
fields.notes: Notice of arrival reference; primary key; cargo_manifest.csv arrival_id joins here

fields.name: vessel_name
fields.notes: Name as submitted on the notice (upper case, no MT/MV prefix)

fields.name: mmsi
fields.notes: 9-digit MMSI; joins vessels.json and the AIS feed

fields.name: imo_number
fields.notes: IMO number with prefix

fields.name: call_sign
fields.notes: Radio call sign

fields.name: flag_state
fields.notes: Flag state

fields.name: vessel_type
fields.notes: Vessel type as declared

fields.name: port_of_arrival
fields.notes: UN/LOCODE of the port of arrival (Corpus Christi)

fields.name: terminal
fields.notes: terminal_registry.json terminal_name; blank if the vessel never berthed

fields.name: terminal_id
fields.notes: terminal_registry.json terminal_id

fields.name: berth_id
fields.notes: terminal_registry.json berth_id of the first berth used

fields.name: anchorage_position_id
fields.notes: terminal_registry.json anchorage position used while waiting offshore; blank if the vessel went straight in

fields.name: draft_arrival_m
fields.notes: Arrival draught in metres

fields.name: port_of_departure
fields.notes: Last port (UN/LOCODE)

fields.name: next_port
fields.notes: Declared next port (UN/LOCODE)

fields.name: noa_submitted_datetime
fields.notes: When the notice of arrival was filed, UTC

fields.name: eta_datetime
fields.notes: Estimated arrival at the sea buoy on the original notice, UTC

fields.name: eta_revised_datetime
fields.notes: Revised estimate if the notice was updated; blank otherwise

fields.name: ata_anchorage_datetime
fields.notes: Time anchored offshore, UTC; blank if the vessel did not anchor

fields.name: ata_datetime
fields.notes: All fast at the berth, UTC; blank if not yet berthed at the end of the data

fields.name: atd_datetime
fields.notes: Departure from the berth, UTC; blank if still alongside at the end of the data

fields.name: voyage_number
fields.notes: Carrier voyage number

fields.name: agent
fields.notes: Ship's agent (fictional)

fields.name: noa_status
fields.notes: State of the call at the end of the data: DEPARTED, IN PORT, REMAINING IN PORT, AT ANCHORAGE, CANCELLED (the vessel did not call: diverted or voyage withdrawn)

fields.name: hold_log
fields.notes: Dated entries the agent added to the notice while the vessel waited (port closed, berth occupied, order numbers)

fields.name: shift_berth_id
fields.notes: Second berth if the vessel shifted within the port

fields.name: shift_datetime
fields.notes: Time of the shift, UTC

cargo_manifest.description: One row per bill of lading (sea) or air waybill (relief cargo flown in).

fields.name: manifest_id
fields.notes: Manifest line number; primary key

fields.name: bl_id
fields.notes: Bill of lading or air waybill number

fields.name: bl_type
fields.notes: Master or House

fields.name: mode
fields.notes: SEA, AIR or ROAD

fields.name: direction
fields.notes: IMPORT, EXPORT or DOMESTIC

fields.name: arrival_id
fields.notes: vessel_arrivals.csv arrival_id for sea cargo; blank for air cargo

fields.name: mmsi
fields.notes: Carrying vessel's MMSI (vessels.json); blank for air cargo

fields.name: vessel_name
fields.notes: Carrying vessel, or the flight / aircraft for air cargo

fields.name: carrier
fields.notes: Carrier (fictional)

fields.name: cargo_description
fields.notes: Commodity description as manifested

fields.name: hs_commodity_code
fields.notes: Harmonized System code

fields.name: quantity
fields.notes: Quantity in unit_of_measure

fields.name: unit_of_measure
fields.notes: BBL barrels, MT metric tons, M3 cubic metres, PALLET, CONTAINER (40 FT), LOT, SHIPMENT

fields.name: cargo_weight_kg
fields.notes: Gross weight in kilograms

fields.name: shipper_name
fields.notes: Shipper (fictional)

fields.name: supplier_id
fields.notes: entity_registry.json id where the shipper is a registered supplier; blank otherwise

fields.name: consignee_name
fields.notes: Consignee (fictional); TO ORDER for negotiable export bills

fields.name: consignee_id
fields.notes: entity_registry.json id where the consignee is a registered entity; blank otherwise

fields.name: port_of_lading
fields.notes: Port or airport of lading

fields.name: port_of_discharge
fields.notes: Port or airport of discharge

fields.name: booking_date
fields.notes: Date the consignment was booked. All dates in this file are calendar dates at the port (US Central time)

fields.name: planned_arrival_date
fields.notes: Arrival date promised at booking

fields.name: arrival_date
fields.notes: Date the cargo actually arrived (vessel berthed or aircraft landed); blank if it has not arrived

fields.name: release_date
fields.notes: Date released to the consignee or, for exports, the sailing date; blank if not released

fields.name: hazmat_flag
fields.notes: Y/N

fields.name: un_number
fields.notes: UN number for hazardous cargo (UN1267 crude oil, UN1972 LNG, UN1203 gasoline, UN1202 diesel)

fields.name: container_numbers
fields.notes: Container numbers, semicolon-separated; blank for bulk cargo

port_conditions.description: Captain of the Port orders, hurricane port conditions and channel status by segment, in the style of Marine Safety Information Bulletins.

fields.name: order_id
fields.notes: Marine Safety Information Bulletin, Captain of the Port order or port authority log number. One order may have several rows, one per segment

fields.name: issued_utc
fields.notes: When the order was published, UTC

fields.name: effective_utc
fields.notes: When it took effect, UTC. A segment's status holds until the next row for that segment

fields.name: authority
fields.example: USCG Captain of the Port, Sector Corpus Christi
fields.notes: Issuing authority

fields.name: order_type
fields.notes: PORT CONDITION, CHANNEL STATUS, VESSEL ORDER, SAFETY ZONE, SECURITY ZONE, NOTICE

fields.name: port_condition
fields.notes: Hurricane port condition in force: SEASONAL ALERT, X-RAY, YANKEE, ZULU, RECOVERY, NORMAL

fields.name: segment_id
fields.notes: Channel segment: SEG-ENT entrance and jetties, SEG-BAY bay reaches, SEG-LAQ La Quinta Channel, SEG-INNER-E Inner Harbor to the Main Turning Basin, SEG-INNER-W Inner Harbor west of the Main Turning Basin, SEG-GIWW Intracoastal Waterway, SEG-ANCH offshore anchorage; blank for orders addressed to one vessel or terminal

fields.name: segment_name
fields.notes: Plain name of the segment

fields.name: status
fields.notes: OPEN, CLOSED, CLOSED TO INBOUND, CLOSED TO DEEP-DRAFT, RESTRICTED (see text); blank for orders not about a segment

fields.name: vessel_mmsi
fields.notes: MMSI of the vessel an order is addressed to (vessels.json); blank otherwise

fields.name: terminal_id
fields.notes: terminal_registry.json terminal an order refers to; blank otherwise

fields.name: text
fields.example: Normal operations. All segments open to all traffic.
fields.notes: The operative text of the order
